json_ld.description:
The Flair Classic is the original Flair Espresso Maker that creates cafe-quality espresso with a direct lever system. Featuring two portafilters, one for beginners and one for advanced home baristas, the Classic allows for full control over all brew variables, with a pressure gauge, small footprint and all metal frame.
The Flair Kettle is an electric gooseneck kettle with digital control and a WARM function for multiple extractions, back to back. Select any brew temperature to ensure precise extraction control, at a fraction of the price of other models.
The Flair eWizard Electric Milk Steamer is a standalone milk steaming wand that features a a cool-touch wand, fast heat-up and two nozzles for beginners and expert latte artists. The eWizard utilizes a unique pressure management system, coupled with an integrated pressure gauge, to ensure perfect steaming pressure and safe use. Only available for 110v systems.
The Flair Brew Scale is a precision digital scale that measures with 0.1g precision to ensure consistent dosing and yields. It features three different weighing modes, a sleek LCD screen and fits under all Flair Espresso Makers.
